admission.justification: The explicit report-only design rejects automatic refusal despite substantial cuts; keeping human causal review separate from diagnostics prevents future check changes from turning visibility into acceptance policy.

alternatives.option: Report measured cuts/additions without new refusals and require independent review of reasons.
alternatives.reason: The approved packet chooses visibility while retaining existing check/gate/closeout behavior; reviewers judge whether the causal task change justifies removal or a requirement owns an addition.

alternatives.option: Automatically refuse a task or closeout because a card was shortened or an outside-knowledge file was added.
alternatives.reason: A justified retirement can correctly remove substantial text, and a program cannot judge whether removed intent remains true. The packet explicitly excludes this refusal.
alternatives.reconsider_when: The developer explicitly replaces the report-only boundary with a new approved acceptance policy and names its defensible causal judgment mechanism.

consequences: The shared threshold selects review observations, not truth or automatic acceptance.
Curator names the causal task change behind removed master text and stores evidence/working files in task or scratch custody; Reviewer owns judgments.
Existing actionable/refusing checks retain their authority.
context: A quality check of only the candidate cannot see deleted card text or outside-knowledge evidence additions; cuts can be justified, so mechanical visibility and independent intent judgment must stay separate.
decider: Approved MIK-R120@v1 under developer directions D47/D124, implementing the standing L86-MASTER-TEXT-REMOVED-RULING; this record does not reverse it.

evidence: mcp/tests/test_landing_report.py (32 tests incl. answer-bound and role-text coverage); evidence5 126 cut cards / 351 added files at memory 38a0362d5; attempt-4 report; provenance-manifest.attempt-4.json
